audience: restaurant owners and managers who run their stores on Linga POS

useCases.title: Check the sale totals of a store
useCases.text: List the stores on the account to find the store id. Read the sale summary report for the date range you need.

useCases.title: Review tenders and open one sale
useCases.text: Read the transaction report of a store for a date range to see payments and tenders. Open one sale by its id to read the details.

useCases.title: Check the active menu items of a store
useCases.text: List the menu items of one store, filtered to active or inactive items. Read the details of the store to confirm it.

useCases.title: Look up a customer record
useCases.text: List the customers saved on the account, then open one record to read its loyalty and contact details.
